item.title: Tyler Reddick wins NASCAR Daytona 500 for Michael Jordan-owned 23XI Racing
item.description: Tyler Reddick won the Daytona 500 in a car owned by Michael Jordan when Chase Elliott crashed as he and Reddick were battling for the win.

item.title: South Side congregation relaunches services after Englewood church collapses in fire on Thanksgiving
item.description: On Sunday, members of a South Side church congregation celebrated the door that was opened to them after a devastating fire saw the collapse of their previous church home on Thanksgiving Day.

item.title: 3 damaged ATMs found in Greater Grand Crossing yard, police say
item.description: Chicago police found three damaged ATMs on the city's South Side on Sunday morning.

item.title: Man, 19, charged with shooting Bronzeville Jewel security guard arrested in Ariz., ordered detained
item.description: A man charged in connection with a shooting at a South Side grocery store back in November was ordered detained on Saturday.

item.title: Former UFC heavyweight champion Cain Velasquez released from prison after 2022 shooting
item.description: Former UFC heavyweight champion Cain Velasquez was released from prison following a 2022 shooting, the California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation confirmed on Sunday. Velasquez was in prison for attempted murder of a man charged with molesting Velasquez's son.

item.title: 2 killed in fiery West Loop crash, Chicago police say
item.description: Two people were found dead in a fiery car crash on Sunday, Chicago police said.

item.title: Quick Tip: Rental scams
item.description: Recent data from the FTC shows renters have lost millions of dollars to schemes, with nearly 65,000 rental scams and $65 million in losses since 2020.

item.title: Chicago Auto Show 2026 at McCormick Place, Feb. 7-16: Hours, ticket prices and more
item.description: The Chicago Automobile Trade Association (CATA), producer of the Chicago Auto Show, released the dates and plans for the 2026 event, which is being held Feb. 7-16 at McCormick Place.

item.title: Leaders react after Chicago teen who called for dad's release from ICE custody dies of cancer
item.description: Chicago teen Ofelia Torres' story rose to the spotlight during her father's immigration case that had him briefly detained by DHS back in October, as she continued to speak out for him and many others along the way.
